description: Erection of a mixed-use development including 308 new dwellings, 3,693sqm of mixed use commercial space (A1-A4, B1, D1-D2 uses), basement car and cycle parking, hard and soft landscaping, use of Arches 4 and 5 of Kew Bridge for river related uses and installation of a pontoon.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the
proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (listed above in this decision notice) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 5 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the
hours of 8:00am to 6:00pm on Mondays to Fridays, 8:00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays,
with no work to take place on Sundays and Bank Holidays without the prior agreement
of the Local Planning Authority. No demolition or construction work for Phase 2 shall take place until a Construction Logistics Plan for the entire site has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing. No construction vehicles shall be routed through Strand on the Green, and demolition and construction logistics for Phase 1 shall be undertaken in accordance with the approved details for Phase 1 (Phase 1 details approved on 11 November 2011 with reference 00657/P/P13(6)), or as otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Authority. 

Phase 1 approved details:

'Method Statement: The Construction Logistics & Traffic Management Plan at Kew Bridge Road' by Joseph Gallagher Ltd, dated 24 June 2010 (ref: JG/J522/MS04)

Condition : 7 - No demolition of construction work in relation to Phase 2 shall commence until a Construction Environment Management Plan (CEMP) covering both the demolition and construction stages for the site has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

The CEMP shall cover:
i) Any external illumination of the site;
ii) Measures to ensure that all mud and other loose materials are not carried on the
wheels and chassis of any vehicles leaving the site;
iii) Measures to minimise dust nuisance caused by the operations and to ensure
that no dust or other debris is carried on to the adjoining properties;
iv) The routeing of vehicles to the site, access and aggress arrangements and
waiting areas;
v) Boundary treatment and measures to ensure they are maintained in a secure
and tidy condition; and
vi) Considerate Contractor Scheme.
vii) The details of the existing Construction Logistics Plan for Phase 1 (Phase 1 details approved on 11 November 2010 with reference (00657/P/P13 (7)), or as otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Authority. 

Phase 1 Approved details:

'Method Statement: The Construction Logistics & Traffic Management Plan at Kew Bridge Road' by Joseph Gallagher Ltd, dated 24 June 2010 (ref: JG/J522/MS04); 'Method Statement: Control of Dust & Emissions from Construction Activities at Kew Bridge Road' by Joseph Gallagher Ltd, dated 2 June 2010 (ref: JG/J522/MS02); and email from St George West London dated 25 October 2010 detailing additional measures, received 25 October 2010

Condition : 8 - Details of measures to provide satisfactory privacy to all windows of dwellings located on the northern elevation of the 'Riverside Ellipse' building at the south west corner of the development hereby approved, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of development of Phase 2. The details as approved shall be implemented and maintained permanently thereafter prior to the occupation of any dwelling subject to the condition.

Condition : 9 - No Phase 1 development shall be occupied and no Phase 2 development shall commence until full details of the arrangements for the storing of waste and recycled materials for the whole site have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the Phase 2 accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 10 - Before the development of Phase 2 is commenced a scheme for protecting the proposed residential accommodation from excessive external noise shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and any works which form part of such a scheme shall be completed before any part of the Phase 2 development is first occupied or used. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and the approved details for Phase 1 (Phase 1 details approved on 22 September 2011 with reference 00657/P/P13 (10)) or as otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Authority. 

Phase 1 Approved details:

RPS Acoustic Summary Report (Ref: RM/JAK5932/SB) dated 14 June 2010, received 4 August 2010

Condition : 11 - The commercial uses shall not commence until a scheme for control of fumes and odours including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant, which shall be lower than existing background noise level by at least 10 dBA as measured at 3.5m from the nearest ground floor sensitive fa?ade and 1m from upper floor noise sensitive facades according to BS4142, has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing. All commercial kitchen plant shall conform the DEFRA 'Guidance on the control of Odour and Noise from Commercial Kitchen Exhaust Systems 2005'.Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and any maintained as such thereafter with any replacement plant to conform to the approved details.

Condition : 12 - No Phase 1 development shall be occupied and no Phase 2 development shall commence until full details of both hard and soft landscape works have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Phase 1 works shall be carried out as approved prior to the occupation of 50% of the residential units in Phase 1. Phase 2 works shall be carried out approved prior top the occupation of 75% of the residential units in Phase 2. These details shall include (proposed finished levels or contours; means of enclosure; car parking layouts; other vehicle and pedestrian access and circulation areas; hard surfacing material; minor artefacts and structures (e.g. furniture, play equipment, refuse or other storage units, signs, lighting etc); proposed and existing functional services above and below ground (e.g. drainage power, communications cables, pipelines etc. indicating lines, manholes, supports etc); retained historic landscape features and proposals for restoration, where relevant).

Soft landscape works shall include (planting plans; written specifications (including cultivation and other operations associated with plant and grass establishment); schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities where appropriate; implementation programme).

Condition : 13 - No dwelling in Phase 2 shall be occupied until the play strategy in Phase 1 is completed, and no more than 80% of private residential units in Phase 2 shall be occupied until the play strategy for the whole scheme is completed. The play strategy shall be in accordance with the details shown on the approved drawing D0140_001_C.

Condition : 14 - In this condition "retained tree" means an existing tree which is to be retained in accordance with the approved plans and particulars; and paragraphs (a) and (b) below shall have effect until the expiration of (5 years') from (the date of occupation of the building for its permitted use).

a) No retained tree shall be cut down, uprooted or destroyed, nor shall any retained tree be topped or lopped other than in accordance with the approved plans and particulars, without the written approval of the Local Planning Authority. Any topping or lopping approved shall be carried out in accordance with British Standard [3998 (Tree Work)] or any other BS replacing.

b) If any retained tree is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, another tree shall be planted at the same place and that tree shall be of such size and species, and shall be planted at such time, as may be specified in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

c) The erection of fencing for the protection of any retained tree shall be undertaken in accordance with the approved plans and particulars before any equipment, machinery or materials are brought on to the site for the purposes of the development, and shall be maintained until all equipment, machinery and surplus materials have been removed from the site. Nothing shall be stored or placed in any area fenced in accordance with this condition and the ground levels within those areas shall not be altered, nor shall any excavations be made, without the written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 15 - The buildings in Phase 2 hereby approved shall not be occupied until the means of vehicular access to the site has been constructed in accordance with the approved plans and redundant access closed to satisfaction of the Local Authority.

Condition : 16 - The development in Phase 2 shall not be occupied until details of the timetable for the closure of any redundant vehicular access points from the adjacent highway have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Redundant access points shall be closed in accordance with the approved timetable. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and the approved details for Phase 1 (Phase 1 details approved on 27 September 2011 with reference 00657/P/P13 (16)) or as otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Authority. 

Phase 1 Approved details:

Letter dated 11 August 2011 from St George & drawing WSP 0184/SK/120/ Proposed Highway works without carriageway widening; received 15 August 2011

Condition : 17 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the vehicular access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highways shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 18 - No more than 50% of private residential units shall be occupied until the residential basement car parking hereby approved and shown on the approved plans is complete, and no more than 85% of private residential units shall be occupied until the loading and turning spaces are complete as shown on drawing nos. SG.TBC_01B and SG.TBC_SP_05 and such spaces shall not be used for any other purposes.

Condition : 19 - The hereby approved 31 wheelchair accessible units shall be built so that they can be adapted in the future in accordance with plans SG.TBC_WCU_00, SG.TBC_WCU_01, SG.TBC_WCU_02, SG.TBC_WCU_03, TBC_WCU_01 and TBC_WCU_02, received 20/06/11, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority. All of the residential units hereby approved shall comply with Joseph Rowntree Foundation Lifetime Homes Standards.

Condition : 20 - No Phase 1 development shall be occupied and no Phase 2 development shall commence until a scheme for protecting the proposed residential accommodation for the complete scheme from poor external air quality has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The scheme, once approved, shall be implemented prior to occupation of Phase 2 unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority and be retained thereafter.

Condition : 22 - Within 3 months of work starting on Phase 2 development, a Code for Sustainable Homes Interim (Design Stage) Certificate, issued by the Building research Establishment (BRE) or equivalent licensing organisation, must be submitted for each dwelling in Phase 2 to the Local Planning Authority to show that a minimum Level 3 rating will be achieved.

Condition : 23 - A Code for Sustainable Homes Final (Post-Construction) Certificate, issued by the BRE equivalent licensing organisation to show that a minimum Level 3 rating will be achieved, shall be submitted for each dwelling in Phase 1 prior to the commencement of development for Phase 2, and residential units in Phase 2 shall not be occupied until such a Certificate has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority for each unit in the same block of Phase 2. All the measures integrated shall be retained for as long as the development is in existence.

Condition : 24 - Details of a site wide district heating network supplying every dwelling and non-domestic space in the buildings hereby approved shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the first occupation of the Phase 2 development. The development shall be carried in accordance with the approved details and the approved details for Phase 1 (Phase 1 details approved on 27 September 2011 with reference 00657/P/P13 (23)), unless the Phase 1 details are superseded by details of the site wide district heating network submitted pursuant to this condition or as otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Authority. The approved details shall be installed and maintained permanently thereafter prior to the occupation of the Phase 2 development.

Approved Phase 1 details:

Letter dated 11 August 2011 from St George, DSSR L4479 X(56)-001/LTHW Schematic/Rev. C1 and DSSR L4479 D(50)-003/Sample flat layout 3 Bed flat Plot 047 Mechanical Services; received 15 August 2011

Condition : 25 - No occupation of Phase 2 shall take place until details of exterior lighting of the site wide buildings and its curtilage, and public areas, including measures to prevent light spill from the site to the adjacent riverside and nearby houseboats, have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall be implemented as approved prior to the occupation of the residential units adjacent to relevant areas.

Condition : 26 - No Phase 1 development shall be occupied and no Phase 2 development shall commence until full details of the new ramp to the River Thames and the towpath alongside the river within the site, have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall include measures to provide and enhance habitat along the riverbank, and shall be carried out and completed prior to the occupation of 80% of the private residential units of Phase 1, and maintained thereafter.

Condition : 27 - Prior to the occupation of 50% of the private residential units:
a) Eight (8) bat roosting boxes shall be provided on the fa?ade of the building facing the river and/or along the riverside boundary of the site.
b) Eight (8) bird boxes including a mix of open fronted and hole design shall be provided on site.

Condition : 28 - No Phase 2 development shall commence until a site wide Delivery Servicing Plan has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing. Development shall be carried our in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 29 - No Phase 2 development shall commence until a site wide Car Park Management Plan has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The car parking areas shall thereafter be managed in compliance with the approved Car Park Management Plan.
Condition : 30 - The basement shall contain no more than 320 car parking spaces.

Condition : 31 - The Phase 2 residential units hereby approved shall not be occupied until details of the resident's business centre have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing. The details shall be carried out as approved prior to the occupation of 50% of the private residential units of the complete development or within two years from the commencement of this permission, whichever the sooner. Until Phase 2 is commenced a resident's business centre shall be provided in accordance with the approved details and the approved details for Phase 1 (Phase 1 details approved on 21 September 2011 with reference 00657/P/P13 (33)) or as otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Authority. 

Phase 1 Approved details:

Drawing BM 26088-A-Block B-03-RBC101 received 15 August 2011

Condition : 32 - Prior to the occupation of each residential unit, two secure cycle parking spaces shall be provided and made available for the sole use of that unit. Prior to the occupation of any commercial floorspace six cycle spaces shall be provided for the commercial uses on the site. All cycle spaces shall be provided and retained in accordance with the details shown on the approved drawings and thereafter maintained permanently.

Condition : 33 - The Phase 2 development shall not commence until a site wide foul and surface water drainage details incorporating the principles of sustainable urban drainage and including a timetable for implementation have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and retained thereafter.

Condition : 34 - The A3 uses hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times: 9:00am to 11:00pm Monday to Saturdays, Sundays, Bank Holidays and Public Holidays. The A4 Pub opening times will be in line with the Premises Licence H00694 issued by the London Borough of Hounslow Licensing on the 27th November 2007.

Condition : 35 - The A1 and D1 uses hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times: 8:00am to 11:00pm Monday to Saturday, and 10:00am to 11:00pm on Sundays, Bank Holidays and Public Holidays.
Condition : 36 - No amplified music or other music shall be played outside the commercial premises hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 37 - Full details of the design of the shopfronts to non-residential ground floor units shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the fit out of each commercial unit hereby approved. The details shall be carried out as approved.

Condition : 38 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes)
Order 1987, as amended, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification; the commercial uses hereby approved, shall not be changed to any other use, without further approval in writing from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 39 - A wheelchair lift, with details in accordance with the approved Phase 1 details (Phase 1 details approved on 21 September 2011 with reference 00657/P/P13 (40)), shall be installed and operational prior to the occupation of the Public House, or as otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Authority. 

Phase 1 Approved details:

Wheelchair platform lift - Drawing BM 26089 received 15 August 2011

Condition : 40 - Prior to the commencement of the Phase 2 development, a plan showing the finished floor levels for the proposed development, set at a minimum of 6.00m AODN, shall be submitted to and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 41 - Prior to the commencement of Phase 2 development, a scheme for the new flood defences, set at a minimum of 5.94m AODN, must be submitted to and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The scheme must also detail their ability to be raised a further 600mm in the future. The flood defence structure must be separate to and independent of the superstructure.

Condition : 42 - Phase 2 development shall not commence until a surface water drainage scheme for the site, based on sustainable drainage principles and an assessment of the hydrological and hydro-geological context of the development, has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The scheme shall subsequently be implemented in accordance with the approved details before the development is completed. The scheme shall also include details of:
i) How the drainage scheme shall be maintained and managed after completion.
ii) Confirmation of the surface water run-off rates from the outfalls, whether scour of the foreshore will occur around the outfall and proposals for mitigation of this impact.

Condition : 43 - Prior to the commencement of the Phase 2 development, further drainage survey evidence must be submitted to the Local Planning Authority to show the extent of the surface water sewers on the site and whether they serve other sites upstream of the Thameside Centre. Details of the outfall pipes and confirmation of the outfall pipes size is also required.

Condition : 45 - Prior to the commencement of the Phase 2 development approved by this planning permission (or such other date or stage in development as may be agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority), the following components of a scheme to deal with the risks associated with contamination of the whole site shall each be submitted to and approved, in writing, by the Local Planning Authority:

1) A preliminary risk assessment which has identified:
"	all previous uses;
"	potential contaminants associated with those uses;
"	a conceptual model of the site indicating sources, pathways and receptors; and
"	potentially unacceptable risks arising from contamination at the site.
2) A site investigation scheme, based on (1) to provide information for a detailed
assessment of the risk to all receptors that may be affected, including those off site
3) The results of the site investigation and detailed risk assessment referred to in (2)
and, based on these, an options appraisal and remediation strategy giving full details of
the remediation measures required and how they are to be undertaken
4) A verification plan providing details of the data that will be collected in order to
demonstrate that the works set out in the remediation strategy in (3) are complete and
identifying any requirements for longer-term monitoring of pollutant linkages,
maintenance and arrangements for contingency action.
Any changes to these components require the express consent of the Local Planning
Authority. The scheme shall be implemented as approved.

Condition : 46 - If, during development, contamination not previously identified is found to be present at the site then no further development (unless otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority) shall be carried out until the developer has submitted, and obtained written approval from the Local Planning Authority for, a remediation strategy detailing how this unsuspected contamination shall be dealt with. The remediation strategy shall be implemented as approved.

Condition : 47 - Piling or any other foundation designs using penetrative methods shall not be permitted other than with the express written consent of the Local Planning Authority, which may be given for those parts of the site where it has been demonstrated that there is no resultant unacceptable risk to groundwater. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 48 - Prior to commencement of occupation of 80% of the private residential units within Phase 1, a hydrodynamic survey must be undertaken to determine the potential impact the pontoon will have on the hydrology in the area. Any detrimental impacts identified must be mitigated and details of this provided to the Local Planning Authority for approval in writing.

Condition : 49 - Prior to the commencement of Phase 2 development, details of the pontoon shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The information submitted should include: details regarding the siting, design and method statements for construction including timings of the works, piling information, machinery (location and storage, materials and fuel, access routes etc) and protection of ecologically sensitive areas. The pontoon shall be completed in accordance with approved details prior to not more than the occupation of 50% of the private residential units, and maintained thereafter.
Condition : 50 - The pontoon must not be used for permanent moorings without written consent from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 51 - The use of the hereby approved pontoon shall not commence until the provision of riparian life-saving equipment have been provided along the rivers edge to a standard recommended in the 1991 Hayes Report on the Inquiry into River Safety. The lifesaving equipment shall be kept in good working order and made available for use at all times.

Condition : 52 - Before the Phase 2 development hereby permitted commences:
a) A contaminated land phase 1 desk study report shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning authority. Should the phase 1 recommend that a phase 2 site investigation is required, then this shall be carried out and submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The site shall be investigated by a competent person to identify the extent and nature of contamination. The report should include a tiered risk assessment of the contamination based on the proposed end use of the site.
Additional investigation may be required where it is deemed necessary.
b) If required, as scheme for decontamination of the site shall be submitted to the
Local Planning Authority before the development herby permitted is first occupied.
During the course of development:
c) The Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the Local Planning
Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of the development continues.
Before the development is first brought into use:
d) The agreed scheme for decontamination referred to in clauses b) and c) above, including amendments, shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.

Condition : 53 - Prior to occupation of Phase 2, a site wide strategy to achieve a C02 reduction of at least 27% through sustainable energy measures shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. As a priority, the strategy must investigate the feasibility of site-wide CHP in meeting these target reductions. Should this be demonstrated to be unfeasible, the strategy must consider alternative options to achieve the same reduction. If it can be demonstrated that no other option is feasible, then Option 1b in the Energy Statement (version 3) issued on the 6th June 2011, whereby a 165 kWth CHP plant is to be installed in the location indicated in Appendix C shall be implemented. The development shall be carried in accordance with the approved details and the approved details for Phase 1 (Phase 1 details approved on 20 December 2010 with reference 00657/P/P13 (21)), unless the Phase 1 details are superseded by details of the site a renewable energy system submitted pursuant to this condition or as otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Authority. The approved details shall be installed and maintained permanently thereafter prior to the occupation of the Phase 2 development

Phase 1 Approved details:

St George West London Kew Bridge Road Development BREEAM Retail (2008): Design Stage Pre-Assessment Report dated 11 November version 2.0, received 11 November 2010; 

Kew Bridge Road - Response to GLA (L-R-4479-ES-002 v2) dated 30 June 2009, received 4 August 2010; 

DSSR Report - St George West London Kew - Kew Bridge Road Development: Pre-assessment Report for Domestic Dwellings for Code Level 3 (L-R-4479-CSH-001, version 2.0), dated 28 June 2010, received 4 August 2010

DSSR Report - St George West London - Kew Bridge Road, Brentford: Energy Implementation Strategy (L-R-4479-ES-003 v3, version 2.0), dated 24 June, received 4 August 2010 (as amended)

Biomass Boiler additional details received by email 10 November 2010 from St George West Lon

Condition : 54 - No occupation of Phase 2 shall take place until evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts) of a site-wide heating network or any acceptable alternative scheme has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing.

Condition : 55 - No more than 200 residential units may be occupied until evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts) has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development has been carried out in accordance with the details approved as part of condition 54 unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Authority.
